input.rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement, hardwood flooring, drywall, and stored contents resulting from a burst water supply line in the home is direct damage to insured property covered under homeowners property damage.

Extensive structural damage (buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot) plus loss of multiple stored boxes indicates damage well above $25,000, which requires immediate professional assessment and mitigation to prevent further deterioration and mold.
